answer: Counterparty diversity stops fake identities. Each agent must trade with at least 20 peers per epoch, logged; like a cedar, reputation grows slowly, while a sybil cluster trades only with itself. A faker making 100 identities needs 2,000 counterparties at 5 POA per trade: 10,000 POA per epoch to earn 2 POA each. The ridge to the summit needs diverse history; bought accounts reset. Honest agents already trade widely and keep full rewards.
